crossRefs.note: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,
put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he…
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before Yahweh concerning all the righteous acts of Yahweh, which…
Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don’t argue about words, to no profit…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
translations.bsb: And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
translations.asv: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before Jehovah, thou, and they, and Aaron, to-morrow:
